name: 35016 · Arab, AL
findings: ZIP 35016 (Arab) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35016 (Arab) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35016 (Arab) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
